scope: Independent second review; no production changes

newFeatureFindings.title: First prompt-history bootstrap can wedge the computer
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Open prompt history on a fresh native task; disconnect before bootstrap reaches the computer.
newFeatureFindings.observed: Hub already marks the prompt-history store active. Computer has no store. Reconnect metadata snapshot rejects; normal commands including terminal stop are blocked.
newFeatureFindings.cause: ensurePromptTask registers active ownership before remote bootstrap ACK. This has no migration to activate, unlike old F02.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Reserve a durable initializing owner before creation, fence task/tab deletion, bootstrap idempotently, publish active only after matching ACK. Recover incomplete initialization explicitly.

newFeatureFindings.title: Reconnect overwrites current settings with stale sibling values
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Two active tabs share a provider. Change model/mode/session on selected root, then reconnect with an untouched sibling.
newFeatureFindings.observed: Actual endpoint tests revert plan → normal, opus → sonnet, and new-session → old-session. Both stores are active; this is distinct from old F07 prepared-store selection.
newFeatureFindings.cause: Each tab caches provider configuration. Recovery replays every sibling by storage ID into task-global settings, with no authority/revision rule. mirrorProviderConfig=false protects conversation records, not provider-config updates.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Define task/provider configuration authority and revision across bootstrap, edits and replay. Restore current state deterministically; do not disable recovery or rely on storage-ID order.

newFeatureFindings.title: Closing a tab during first bootstrap resurrects it
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Computer commits first bootstrap; hold reply. Delete the actual terminal tab while no hub owner exists. Release reply and reconnect.
newFeatureFindings.observed: Late registration publishes an active locator; recovery recreates the deleted visible tab.
newFeatureFindings.cause: Ordinary chat creates remote storage before publishing its locator. Delete trigger has no owner to tombstone in that interval. Simply reversing order causes F14-style missing-store failures.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Use initializing reservation plus per-tab deletion fence and a conditional post-ACK activation. Apply the protocol to all store creators, not just prompt history.
newFeatureFindings.test: recovery-second-pass.test.ts — deleting a tab while its first bootstrap reply is pending

newFeatureFindings.title: Concurrent retries of one upload create two files
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Send two simultaneous strict artifact RPC requests with identical operation ID and input.
newFeatureFindings.observed: Both requests create different artifacts. Sequential retry correctly returns one cached result; concurrent reuse with different input is correctly rejected.
newFeatureFindings.cause: Artifact receipt is checked before asynchronous scope checks. acceptCommand later returns duplicate, but its result is ignored and both mutations continue.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Join identical in-flight operations using conversation + operation ID, while validating input hash before joining. Keep durable accepted-but-unconfirmed behavior after process death.

newFeatureFindings.title: Acknowledged tab deletion leaves raw transfer history
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Stage a migration, delete the tab before activation, deliver deletion and ACK, then restart computer.
newFeatureFindings.observed: Hub and computer are tombstoned; cleanupPending=false and source rows are gone. Raw transfers/*.data still contains deleted history indefinitely.
newFeatureFindings.cause: Conversation tombstone does not erase transfer staging; collectActivated only handles active stores.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Erase transfer state per conversation idempotently, retry on startup, and acknowledge deletion only after required cleanup completes. Preserve unrelated stores and deliberate backups.
newFeatureFindings.test: recovery-second-pass.test.ts — deleting prepared chat tab erases staged bytes

newFeatureFindings.title: Failed uploads retain private temp bytes after deletion
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Partially write a sealed attachment then fail with ENOSPC. Permanently delete task, reopen, run both garbage collectors.
newFeatureFindings.observed: Flat .upload-* file retains partial private payload after deletion/restart. Sharded temp files have an inherited version of the same problem.
newFeatureFindings.cause: writeBlob closes the descriptor on failure but does not remove its staging file. Collector ignores filenames that are not complete hashes.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Clean every failed staging path; safely track/collect abandoned staging across restart and retry cleanup failures. Do not remove active uploads blindly.
newFeatureFindings.test: durability-second-pass.test.ts — failed attachment staging retains no payload

newFeatureFindings.title: Session picker refuses supported native-to-chat handoff
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Select this task’s running native conversation in Sessions picker.
newFeatureFindings.observed: New hub guard refuses before terminal-release callback; release called zero times. Explicit continueInChat control passes.
newFeatureFindings.cause: New beforeInvoke releases native lease for continueInChat/takeOver only. Existing switchConversation contract also requires release before dispatch.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Preserve explicit picker handoff under the same task/session ownership proofs. Await verified native release before starting chat; never allow two holders.
newFeatureFindings.test: runtime-second-pass.test.ts — picker releases selected native holder

newFeatureFindings.title: Ephemeral /btw answers persist in SQLite receipts
newFeatureFindings.trigger: Complete a side question through real Claude driver with a fake child; close and reopen computer store.
newFeatureFindings.observed: Answer is absent from event/record history but survives verbatim in receipt.result. Domain contract explicitly says no DB persistence; answer should live only in renderer card.
newFeatureFindings.cause: Generic invoker persists every non-read operation result, including side-question text. Full SQLite backups include those rows by source inspection; separate backup extraction was not tested.
newFeatureFindings.fix: Separate idempotency/delivery receipts from response-content retention. Keep side-answer result ephemeral while preventing unintended duplicate provider calls.

expandedPriorFindings.title: Old-backup reconciliation is still broken
expandedPriorFindings.detail: Independently reproduced using actual SQLite backups rather than manually rewound locators. Legacy snapshot + prepared destination conflicts. Snapshot predating locator creates a second storage ID; old prepared store remains and native admission rejects Task chat migration is pending. Copying snapshot + prepared destination is a passing control.

expandedPriorFindings.title: Archive verification needs semantic completeness
expandedPriorFindings.detail: In addition to omitted blobs, unsupported schema, missing events table and malformed event JSON can become verified archives. Missing table/invalid JSON archives later fail reads. Malformed JSON came from the disposable live store before normal backup.create. These are expansions of F11, not three new defects.

inheritedRisks.title: Working original and committed HEAD diverge
inheritedRisks.detail: ENOSPC or an invalid historical ref rejects the write after changing the visible original. Mutating old v1 can also leave original showing v1 while HEAD is v2. Survives reopen. Shared artifact-store transaction code predates this feature.

inheritedRisks.title: Prune rollback cannot restore physically deleted blobs
inheritedRisks.detail: Second unlink fails; SQLite restores all version rows, but first historical blob is already gone. Explicit version read returns ENOENT. Shared prune code is unchanged by migration.

inheritedRisks.title: Explicit hashed version read returns corrupted bytes
inheritedRisks.detail: Read uses saved content hash, not mutable working copy. Returned version claims original hash/size while bytes are corrupt. Shared read behavior is inherited; computer endpoint exposes it too. Flat sealed reads correctly reject corruption.

inheritedRisks.title: Sharded blob staging leaks partial temp files
inheritedRisks.detail: Partial write failure leaves blobs/.tmp payload after permanent deletion. Existing shared BlobStore write path already escaped cleanup; flat computer attachment case F19 is new.

inheritedRisks.title: Slow attachment admission lets later queue entries overtake
inheritedRisks.detail: Reproduced ordering inversion, but asynchronous admission existed before migration. New hub sealing adds delay; this is not counted as a new feature regression. Mobile draft-persistence absence is also uncounted.
inheritedRisks.source: runtime-second-pass.test.ts — explicitly labeled preexisting FIFO case
